_comment: Local cache of fonts used by the resume (public/resume/Mitchell-Palmer-Resume.odt). Used by embed_fonts.py to re-embed brand fonts into a temp copy before exporting docx/pdf, so rendering is correct regardless of what fonts are installed on the machine doing the export. All fonts here are open-source (SIL Open Font License, Google Fonts).

skip_no_embed_needed.Lexend ExtraBold: Intentionally left without its own embedded font file. The title style (T1) requests this face at fo:font-weight="normal", relying on the glyph shapes alone to look extra-bold, not on a bold instruction. Giving it its own dedicated embed (even at weight=normal) caused LibreOffice to mismatch and render the title in a thinner weight than intended -- tested and confirmed. Leaving it unembedded lets LibreOffice fall back to the base 'Lexend' family's embedded Regular weight, which renders the title correctly. If this ever needs debugging again: re-embedding this face directly is the wrong fix, even though it seems like the more 'correct' one.
skip_no_embed_needed.Lexend ExtraBold1: Same as 'Lexend ExtraBold' above (CJK/complex-script duplicate declaration).
